column3: Samsung could unseat SK Hynix as HBM leader in 2027
column4: Samsung Electronics could overtake SK Hynix as the world's largest supplier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) in 2027, as HBM4 prices climb and memory manufacturers compete for limited DRAM production capacity, according to forecasts presented at an October 6 semiconductor industry forum in Seoul.

column3: Cook makes first post-CEO visit to China, lauds Guangdong's role in Apple supply chain
column4: Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook made his first visit to China since stepping down as Apple CEO. He visited Guangdong Province, a manufacturing hub that contains much of the iPhone maker's supply chain ecosystem as it rolls out the iPhone 18 Pro series and its first foldable smartphones.
